sources: amazon.com search: portable electric coffee grinder rechargeable
costSource: 1688 via DSers: 'Hand Brewed Italian Grinder Automatic Coffee Machine Rechargeable', item US$9.29, Standard shipping to US US$18.35, 9-12 days, tracking available, 59447 pieces available, 3880 orders on 1688. NOTE shipping is per-product on 1688 - the watch roll on the same platform quotes $23.55, so do not carry a shipping figure between products.
dutyRateBasis: HTS 8509.40.00 'Food grinders, processors and mixers; fruit or vegetable juice extractors'. Column 1 general 4.2% + 12.5% Section 301 under subheading 9903.05.31 (US note 52) = 16.7%. Two independent tariff references agree, one synced 2026-09-07. NOT the 55.1% watch-roll stack: 8509.40 does not carry a List 1-3 25% layer. VERIFY with a broker before a first commercial order - third-party tariff sites are a cross-check, not a ruling.
verdict: PASSES both rules at a sourced 16.7% duty rate, but by less than it first appeared. Under the binding 'prepaid' basis it contributes $19.62/unit at $49.99. Supplier prepaying duty on wholesale (DDP) gives $12.31 - THIRTY-ONE CENTS over the $12 floor, so that scenario is now effectively marginal rather than comfortable. Duty on retail transaction value reaching us gives $8.58 and fails RULE 1. THREE CAUTIONS. Retail $49.99 sits almost exactly on the band ceiling of $50.08, so any softening of the market breaks rule 2. Two of the three duty scenarios now sit within $0.31 of the floor or below it, which means a supplier price rise of a dollar closes this candidate. And the category is wide and open - top review count 565, real volume at $45.11 (390 reviews, 300+/mo) and $199.99 (565, 300+/mo) - which is the opposite of the pest-control shape where an incumbent owned the shelf.
batteryNote: ~1000mAh cell, roughly 3.7 Wh at 3.7V - far below the 20 Wh per-cell threshold, so it is UN3481 contained-in-equipment in the excepted band, which is the ordinary case for consumer rechargeables out of China. Packaging, state-of-charge and labelling are the SHIPPER's obligation in China, not ours. Observable fact: the supplier already quotes a US method (Standard, $18.35, 9-12 days, tracking), so their line accepts it. Residual risks are occasional carrier rejection or delay, and product-liability exposure on an electrical item that a leather pouch does not carry. CONFIRM the actual cell rating before ordering - the figure is read off marketing copy.
collectedShippingNote: Figures below use the CORRECTED US delivery profile: a flat CA$6.99 with no free tier, about US$4.99 collected on every US order. An earlier reading of this candidate quoted $22.22/$14.92/$11.18 because the model was still applying Canada's free-over-$50 rule to the US zone, which credited $8 on a sub-$50 order. Every figure here is about $2.60 lower as a result.
